source: Official yuanty/fastwam model repository, public API and README verified 2026-10-10

metadata_probe.method: Public HTTP Range, first 524288 bytes; restricted metadata-only parser, no Torch weights loaded

transfer: Keep every original policy weight via strict loading. ForceVLA raw state7 is normalized with shared wipe statistics then zero-padded to8 using the stock ConcatLeftAlign merger. Actions remain7.
normalization: Use ForceVLA shared all_train stats, not the release LIBERO stats. Robot/tasks/coordinates differ; finetuning is required.
scheduler: Current official codebase action shift1 is used for finetuning/inference. README says the original base release used action shift5.
